These are my best guesses from the page alone. The page never names the verbs I use, such as `filter`, `sort`, `lower`, `groupBy`, `split` or `sum`, so I could not check any of them. Several queries may fail on a wrong verb name or on how a path argument like `mul /price` is resolved.

H1: `filter (/active | eq true) | filter (/country | lower | eq "de") | filter (/age | gte 30) * /name | sort`
H2: `filter (/status | lower | eq "paid") | flatMap /items * (/qty | mul /price) | sum | round 2`
H3: `groupBy (/customer | lower) * count`
H4: `{:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys | sort)}`
H5: `filter (/state | eq "open") | sortBy [{:k /comments :desc true} {:k /id}] | take 3 * /id`
H6: `flatMap (/labels | default []) * lower | distinct | sort`
H7: `filter (/state | eq "open") | groupBy (/assignee/login | default "unassigned") * count`
H8: `split "\n" | filter (trim | count | gt 0) * split " " | filter (/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy /2 * count`
H9: `split "\n" | filter (trim | count | gt 0) * split " " | filter (/1 | in ["ERROR" "WARN"]) * (drop 3 | find (startsWith "user=") | replace "user=" "") | filter (ne null) | distinct | sort`
H10: `split "\n" | drop 1 * split "," | filter (/4 | lower | eq "up") | filter (/2 | ne "") | groupBy /1 * (* (/2 | toNumber) | avg | round 1)`
H11: `split "\n" | filter (trim | count | gt 0) | filter (startsWith "#" | not) | filter (split "=" | /0 | lower | startsWith "db_") | toMap (split "=" | {:k (/0 | drop 3 | lower) :v (drop 1 | join "=")})`
H12: `/services | filter (/enabled | eq true) | sortBy /name * {:name /name :timeout (/timeout | default (/defaults/timeout)) :team (/owner/team | default "none")}`
H13: `/results | filter (/score | gte 50) | sortBy [{:k /score :desc true}] * (/profile/first | add " " | add /profile/last | add ": " | add (/tags | default [] | join "|"))`
H14: `lower | matchAll "[a-z]+" | groupBy (identity) * count | toEntries | sortBy [{:k /value :desc true} {:k /key}] | take 3 * {:word /key :count /value}`
